name: feature-carousel
title: Feature Carousel
description: A dark feature card that walks through four build steps. Each step lights its chip, slides in a heading and copy, and cross-fades to a new set of product screenshots every few seconds.
use: You want to walk through several product capabilities in one card without the visitor clicking.
avoid: A visitor must study one screenshot: it moves on every three seconds and cannot be paused.
a11y: Step chips are divs with click handlers and no tab stop, so the carousel cannot be advanced from the keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large dark rounded card with a row of four small step chips across the top. On the left a bold white heading and two lines of grey copy; framed screenshots of a code editor, laptop and analytics dashboard sit to the right or below, each with a thin light border and heavy shadow.
behaves: Every three seconds the card advances: the current chip glows lime, the heading and copy rise in, and the old screenshots slide or fade out as the next set arrives. Clicking anywhere on the card jumps to the next step.
customise: The image set, alt text and per-image classes are props; the four step names, headings and descriptions are hardcoded, so changing them means editing the file.
weight: moderate: Several large screenshots cross-fade inside a spring-driven card with a timer.
